title: The CR's own examples, chapter 3 (Card Types)
blind: Written from the CR text, printed card text and rulings (the lookup skill) only. The engine's src/, tests and baselines were not read. Committed before the comparison for this batch existed.
defaults: Unless a case says otherwise: the Runner has the default 4 MU and no link, both identities are blank, servers have no ice, the Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5, zones not mentioned hold only cards with no relevant abilities, neither player spends credits on a trace, and the Corp declines to rez or use anything not listed in the steps.

cases.position: Corp's turn, 5 credits. Vanity Project is installed in a remote server with 6 advancement counters. HQ holds exactly one card, Archangel. The Runner has Gang Sign and Devil Charm installed and no icebreakers.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The Corp scores Vanity Project. Gang Sign breaches HQ and the Runner accesses Archangel. The Corp pays 3 credits so the Runner encounters it. The Runner removes Devil Charm from the game for its ability.

steps.label: after
steps.do: The Runner breaks nothing. The subroutine's trace resolves with no spending, the encounter ends and the breach finishes.

expect.why: The encounter happens outside a run.
No run is in progress, so the reduction lasted only for the encounter.
Trace 6 against link 0 succeeds, and Gang Sign is the only installed Runner card left.
Archangel has no trash cost, so it stays in HQ.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 5 credits. Corroder is installed. A rezzed Wall of Static is the only ice protecting HQ.

steps.label: pump
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Wall of Static and uses Corroder's '+1 strength' once.

steps.label: passed
steps.do: The Runner breaks the subroutine with Corroder, the encounter ends and the Runner passes Wall of Static. Read in the movement phase, while the run is still in progress.

expect.why: No duration is printed, so the increase ends with the encounter.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 5 credits. Gordian Blade is installed. HQ is protected by a rezzed Thimblerig (innermost) and a rezzed Enigma (outermost).

steps.label: pump
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Enigma and uses Gordian Blade's '+1 strength' once.

steps.label: next-encounter
steps.do: The Runner breaks both of Enigma's subroutines, passes it and encounters Thimblerig.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner breaks Thimblerig's subroutine and passes it; the Corp does not swap Thimblerig. The run is successful and ends.

expect.why: The printed duration is the rest of the run, so the increase outlives the encounter it was triggered in.
Both the run and the encounter are over.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 5 credits. Gordian Blade is installed. A rezzed Enigma is the only ice protecting HQ.

steps.label: approach-pump
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and, in the paid ability window while approaching Enigma (step 6.9.2b), uses Gordian Blade's '+1 strength' once.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: The Runner breaks both subroutines and the run ends.

expect.why: A paid ability with no 'Interface' flag can be used in any paid ability window.
The increase applies until the end of the run whether it was triggered during an encounter or another step of the run.

cases.position: Corp's turn, 5 credits. Vanity Project is installed in a remote server with 6 advancement counters. HQ holds exactly one card, Archangel. The Runner has Gang Sign and Gordian Blade installed and 5 credits.

steps.label: pump
steps.do: The Corp scores Vanity Project. Gang Sign breaches HQ, the Runner accesses Archangel and the Corp pays 3 credits so the Runner encounters it, with no run in progress. The Runner uses Gordian Blade's '+1 strength' four times.

steps.label: after
steps.do: The Runner breaks Archangel's subroutine with Gordian Blade. The encounter ends and the breach finishes.

expect.why: The encounter is outside a run, so the increase lasts for that encounter only.
The subroutine was broken, so no card went back to the grip.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 5 credits, no run in progress. Corroder is installed.

steps.label: pump
steps.do: In a paid ability window of the action phase, with no run in progress, the Runner uses Corroder's '+1 strength' once.

expect.why: The strength ability has no 'Interface' flag, so it can be used outside an encounter.
The increase expires at the next checkpoint, which comes before either player can act again.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 5 credits. Corroder is installed. A rezzed Wall of Static is the only ice protecting HQ.

steps.label: approach-pump
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ and, in the paid ability window while approaching Wall of Static (step 6.9.2b), uses Corroder's '+1 strength' once.

steps.label: encounter
steps.do: The encounter with Wall of Static begins.

expect.why: Used outside an encounter with no other duration, the increase is gone by the next checkpoint and does not reach the encounter.
